name: android-remote-lab
description: Secure on-demand control and physical-device testing for Android through a Windows relay
author: heelee912

scripts.build-launcher: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows/Build-Launcher.ps1 && powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows/Build-Launcher.ps1 -SourcePath windows/WebOsArcGuardLauncher.cs -OutputPath windows/WebOsArcGuardLauncher.exe -ManifestPath windows/WebOsArcGuardLauncher.manifest.json
scripts.check: node --check src/relay.js && node --check src/client.js && node --check src/system-input.js && node --check src/adb-device.js && node --check src/adb-tunnel.js && node --check src/adb-route.js && node --check src/adb-presence.js && node --check src/privileged-shell.js && node --check src/banking-debug-window.js && node --check src/adapter.mjs && node --check src/tv-remote-direct.mjs && node --check src/webos-direct.mjs && node --check src/webos-luna.mjs && node --check src/webos-arc-guard.mjs && node --check bin/arlab.mjs && node --check bin/arlab-tv.mjs && node --check bin/arlab-webos.mjs
scripts.test: node test/relay.test.js && node test/client-session.test.js && node test/client-install.test.js && node test/doctor.test.mjs && node test/wake.test.mjs && node test/selector.test.js && node --test test/android-manifest.test.mjs test/system-input.test.js test/adb-device.test.js test/adb-tunnel.test.js test/adb-route.test.js test/adb-presence.test.js test/privileged-shell.test.js test/banking-debug-window.test.js test/adb-cli.test.mjs test/tv-remote-direct.test.mjs test/webos-direct.test.mjs test/webos-luna.test.mjs test/webos-arc-guard.test.mjs
scripts.validate-launcher: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows/Verify-Launcher.ps1 && powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows/Verify-Launcher.ps1 -SourcePath windows/WebOsArcGuardLauncher.cs -ExecutablePath windows/WebOsArcGuardLauncher.exe -ManifestPath windows/WebOsArcGuardLauncher.manifest.json
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm test && npm run validate-launcher && npm run validate-powershell && npm run validate-skill
